name: ai-fullstack-starter
description: A minimal React + Express TypeScript starter for AI-assisted development with OpenCode.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
